title: Working out logarithms
goal: I can work out logarithms with and without a calculator.
teach: logb b = 1, logb 1 = 0 and logb bⁿ = n. Write the number as a power of the base when you can. Otherwise use the change of base rule: logb x = log x ÷ log b, and a calculator.

steps: Write both as powers of 3: 9 = 3² and 27 = 3³.
x = 32, so log9 27 = 32.

watch: log 0 and the log of a negative number are not defined.

qs.steps:
1. Definition: logb x = y means bʸ = x (b > 0, b ≠ 1, x > 0). The log is the exponent.
2. log₅ 1: 5 to what power gives 1?
3. 5⁰ = 1, so log₅ 1 = 0

qs.hint: 4 to what power gives 2? Think of square roots.
